fee_profiles.source: DEGIRO fee schedule, Basic/Active/Trader, updated 1 January 2026 (EUR 3.90 per order + EUR 1.00 handling fee; third-party costs included in the handling fee; transaction taxes passed on)

fee_profiles.name: DEGIRO ETF Core Selection (used for the S&P 500 UCITS ETF benchmark on Xetra)
warnings: Core Selection membership of the chosen ETF must be re-checked; otherwise EUR 2.00 + EUR 1.00 applies.
fee_profiles.source: DEGIRO fee schedule, updated 1 January 2026 (ETF Core Selection EUR 0.00 + EUR 1.00 handling; fair-use policy). Verify SXR8 is in the current Core Selection list.

fee_profiles.name: Eurobank Equities, Eurobank Trader platform (0.35%, min EUR 6.00)
fee_profiles.source: Eurobank Equities charges page (eurobankequities.gr/el/xreoseis): Eurobank Trader 0.35% min EUR 6.00; exchange & clearing 0.0325% + settlement 0.040% + EUR 0.50 per security per contract note + EUR 0.06 per executed order; sales tax 0.10%; custody only above EUR 15,000.

fee_profiles.name: Freedom24, Smart plan (EUR 2.00 per order + EUR 0.02 per share)
warnings: Per-share pricing makes low-priced names (e.g. CREDIA, BYLOT, ELHA) materially more expensive than DEGIRO at EUR 2,500 order size.
No Athens-specific line in the published schedule; modelled under the "Europe" tariff.
fee_profiles.source: Freedom Finance Europe, Appendix 11 Fee Schedule (US & Europe stocks; Smart plan); 2026 third-party reviews quote the same numbers. Direct ATHEX member since 2025, clearing via Piraeus Bank. Greek transaction tax passed on.

fee_profiles.name: NBG Securities, retail (1.00% up to EUR 3,000, tiered above, min EUR 5.00)
fee_profiles.source: NBG Securities "Transactions in shares/ETFs/bonds listed on ATHEX or CSE", last update 12 May 2025. Execution fee 1.00% up to EUR 3,000, 0.75% for 3,001-9,000, 0.50% above (marginal); minimum EUR 5.00 per order; AthexClear rights 0.02%, clearing 0.03%, ATHEX commission 0.0125%, settlement instruction EUR 0.50; sales tax 0.10%; custody waived below EUR 15,000.

fee_profiles.name: Piraeus Securities, online trading (0.35%, minimum not published)
warnings: UNVERIFIED MINIMUM - the published price list does not state a minimum commission per order; modelled as none. A hidden minimum would change this profile's ranking at the EUR 1,000 book size entirely. Confirm with the broker before relying on it.
fee_profiles.source: Piraeus Securities price list ("Τιμολόγιο βασικών εργασιών"): online trading commission 0.35%, minimum column blank; plus transfer/other expenses and taxes; account maintenance EUR 4/quarter (portfolio EUR 100-10,000), EUR 5/quarter (10,001-50,000), EUR 6/quarter above. Third-party costs modelled at the standard ATHEX set (0.0625% + EUR 0.50).
